subject: B pipeline
finding: The new M8 `fileText` producer is gated on `route !== 'final'`, but both stores (`panel.js recordHistory` and `sotto_webview.history_append`) refuse `provisional-draft`; the only route that reaches disk is `final`, where `fileText` is never set. The field therefore never reaches the transcript, and the panel's `body = meta.fileText || meta.text` consumer is dead for every line that is actually written.
evidence: `caption-formulation.js:837-845` sets `meta.fileText` only when `route !== 'final'`. `panel.js:2160-2161` returns before `pushEntry` when `route !== 'final'`. `history-store.js:289` and `sotto_webview.py:14209-14216` both refuse `provisional-draft`. `history-route-oracle.js` arm 4 asserts `fileText` on a draft (engine-only) but arm 5 writes only final lines and checks route marks, never the body punctuation; `history-write-oracle.py` has no `fileText` arm. The file still carries the mark `formulate()` invented.
suggested_fix: Set `fileText` on the route the transcript records (`if (route === 'final') { const bare = text.replace(/[.!?…]+$/u, ''); if (bare) meta.fileText = bare; }`) and add a `history-write-oracle` arm that writes a final line whose text was punctuated by `formulate()` and asserts the on-disk body is unpunctuated; or delete the field and the panel consumer if the file is allowed to keep the invented mark.

subject: A UI
finding: Moving `#menu-button` into `.panel__controls` widens the fixed, right-anchored control row by 32px (28px button + 4px gap), moving its left edge from the measured 102px to 70px. The wordmark's measured right edge is 71px (`panel.css:3392`), so the lamp now overlaps the wordmark by 1px. The replacement gate only checks `model[0].left >= 0`, so the old 31px header gap is no longer protected.
evidence: The removed `panel.html` comment said 'The header leaves a 31 px gap between the wordmark (right edge 71) and the cluster (left 102), and this control takes its own pixel there instead of moving anyone.' `panel.css:3381-3383` fixes `gap: 4px` and 28px buttons; the retired `MEASURED` table in `panel-header-oracle.js` had cluster left 102; the new arm `(c)` checks only menu-hide order and `model[0].left >= 0`. `panel-themes-oracle.mjs` checks only `hide.left - menu.right`, not the wordmark.
suggested_fix: Recover the 32px before landing (e.g. `#theme-button { max-width: 64px }` plus `.panel__controls { gap: 2px }`), or add a `panel-header-oracle` arm `row.left >= wordmark.right` and a `panel-themes-oracle` relation for the same, so the overlap cannot ship silently.

subject: B pipeline
finding: `live_source_set` was added by commit 011e196 but has no caller anywhere. The source is built through `live_source()` in `sotto_webview.py:4478/15874`; the `set` adoption API is the dead one, and no oracle references it, so the adoption path it was written for is untested and unreachable.
evidence: `grep -rn "live_source_set" app/ _main/` returns only the definition at `youtube_cdp_source.py:1004`; `grep -n "live_source" _main/youtube-cdp-source-oracle.py` returns nothing. Production uses `live_source()` at `sotto_webview.py:4478` and `15874`; nothing calls `live_source_set`.
suggested_fix: Remove `live_source_set` (and its `_LIVE_SOURCE` adoption comment) if the adoption path does not exist, or call it from the code that builds a source outside `live_source` and add an oracle arm that exercises that path; the current export-only symbol is dead and untested.

subject: A UI
finding: The Node store's new `replace` branch writes `line` with only the new `context`, so a growing line that arrives without context loses the `ctx1=` token from the previous line. The Python twin explicitly merges `_prev_ctx` on replace, so the two implementations disagree on the same merge decision.
evidence: `history-store.js:290-300` computes `context = normalizeContext(meta.context)`, then `rows.pop(); rows.push(line.trimEnd())` where `line` uses only that context. `sotto_webview.py:14236-14242` reads `_prev.get('context')` and merges it into `_ctx` when `action == 'replace'`. The Node twin is used by `history-route-oracle.js` and `historico-vs-redux-probe.js`, not by the panel.
suggested_fix: Read `lastLine(file)` once in `append`, and when `action === 'replace'` merge its `context` under the new context before `encodeContext` (the Python twin's `_prev_ctx` update); add a Node arm that replaces a line with an empty context and asserts the token survives.
